Name: Ch1_Zafir_01
Line: You ask a lot of questions for someone with a knife in her sleeve, Little Ember.

Name: Ch1_Zafir_02
Line: The garden guard turns at the fountain. Speak softer, or don't speak at all.

Name: Ch1_Zafir_03
Line: Ask me again and you'll get the same answer.

Name: Ch1_Zafir_04
Line: Careful. Fire burns the hand that holds it too tight.

Name: Ch1_Zafir_05
Line: You danced well tonight. That's not a trick. Just true.

Name: Ch1_Zafir_06
Line: A blade? On a dancer? Someone's been listening at lattice screens.

Name: Ch1_Zafir_07
Line: Here's a thought: you forget what you've heard about me, and I forget what I've seen about you.

Name: Ch1_Zafir_PLACEHOLDER_H1
Line: (He looks toward the fountain and says nothing.)

Name: Ch1_Zafir_PLACEHOLDER_H3
Line: (He holds your gaze for a moment, then turns away.)
